channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's curated vulnerabilities emphasize widespread remote code execution and authentication bypass risks within cloud environments, web platforms, and network infrastructure. Notable active exploitation impacts VMware and Apache Roller, while unauthenticated attacks threaten D-Link routers, Synology NAS, and Kubernetes deployments. Additional critical findings include memory corruption flaws in industrial controllers and AMD firmware, plus sandbox escapes in Ghostscript and library overflows in libstdc++, underscoring persistent dangers in system-level components.

item.title: CVE-2026-74127 — Desktop OS
item.description: Bypasses secure boot authentication in AMD PSP Boot ROM, allowing local attackers to execute arbitrary unsigned code at full processor privilege levels.

item.title: CVE-2026-61963 — Desktop OS
item.description: Improper input validation in the AmdPlatformRasSmm driver enables privileged attackers to overwrite SMRAM, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-78367 — Desktop OS
item.description: Flaw in RPM's tarball processing passes attacker-controlled archive names to macro expansion, risking arbitrary code execution during package builds.

item.title: CVE-2026-130683 — Desktop OS
item.description: Incomplete path validation in SiYuan allows administrators to write payloads outside the designated workspace, leading to local system compromise.

item.title: CVE-2026-130679 — Desktop OS
item.description: Stored XSS in attribute view rendering enables attackers to inject malicious scripts via unescaped image attributes, targeting local note-taking workflows.

item.title: CVE-2026-133993 — IoT Security
item.description: Remote stack-based buffer overflow in the D-Link router GENA subscription handler enables complete device compromise without authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-134287 — IoT Security
item.description: Authentication bypass in OpenRemote MQTT handler allows unauthenticated attackers to impersonate provisioned IoT devices without verifying private keys.

item.title: CVE-2024-10441 — IoT Security
item.description: Improper output encoding in Synology DSM/BSM system plugins enables unauthenticated remote code execution, directly impacting NAS storage appliances.

item.title: CVE-2026-134452 — Cloud Security
item.description: Unfiltered environment variable merging during Docker Compose spawns allows authenticated users to inject malicious binaries and achieve OS command execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-134352 — Cloud Security
item.description: SFTP authentication proxy omits the auth method from its cache key, enabling IP-based session reuse and unauthorized access across different credential types.

item.title: CVE-2026-134448 — Cloud Security
item.description: Path traversal via unvalidated envPath parameter lets low-privileged users read and write arbitrary host files, including SSH keys and system configurations.

item.title: CVE-2026-123890 — Cloud Security
item.description: Authentication bypass in VMware Directory Service is actively exploited, granting full administrative control over vCenter environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-75521 — Cloud Security
item.description: Missing certificate chain verification on the QUIC/HTTP3 RPC server allows complete authentication bypass, compromising the Miren application platform.

item.title: CVE-2026-130007 — Cloud Security
item.description: Exposes an unauthenticated Server-Sent Events interface on all network interfaces, risking unauthorized cluster management in Kubernetes deployments.

item.title: CVE-2026-130644 — Cloud Security
item.description: Validates collection metadata insufficiently during installation, enabling path traversal attacks that could compromise infrastructure-as-code pipelines.

item.title: CVE-2026-133985 — Network Devices
item.description: Remote out-of-bounds read in TRENDnet router config restoration function may leak sensitive memory contents or crash the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-134454 — Network Devices
item.description: ACL bypass via UDP session reuse allows authenticated tunnel clients to route traffic to blocked internal network addresses.

item.title: CVE-2026-134456 — Network Devices
item.description: Unbounded HTTP header size processing in Hysteria's HTTP sniff implementation causes server-side memory exhaustion and denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-76466 — Network Devices
item.description: Persistent cookie exploitation in Cisco Expressway’s database service allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute OS commands as root.

item.title: CVE-2026-129811 — Industrial Control
item.description: Master-supplied PDO mapping bit lengths lack total size validation, enabling buffer overflows in process data handlers that can disrupt controller operations.

item.title: CVE-2026-129798 — Industrial Control
item.description: Segmented SDO download handler fails to track cumulative write bytes, allowing masters to push data past buffer boundaries and corrupt internal state.

item.title: CVE-2026-129794 — Industrial Control
item.description: EoE fragment reassembly uses wire-reported frame sizes as memcpy bounds without validation, risking application buffer corruption and potential remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-129289 — Web Security
item.description: PHP-FPM request smuggling occurs because unread HTTP bodies are not discarded at shutdown, allowing backend connection reuse attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-125294 — Web Security
item.description: Unicode look-alike bypass in WordPress Nexter Blocks Pro denylist enables unauthenticated privilege escalation to administrator roles.

item.title: CVE-2026-133120 — Web Security
item.description: @fastify/express compatibility layer passes mismatched URLs to Express, allowing attackers to completely bypass path-scoped security middleware.

item.title: CVE-2026-134253 — Web Security
item.description: Grav API blueprint-upload endpoint permits theme template file writes by authorized publishers, directly leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-134389 — Web Security
item.description: Missing authorization checks in Frappe ERPNext Payment Requests expose sensitive source documents to unauthorized Accounts Users.

item.title: CVE-2026-128361 — Web Security
item.description: Phoenix Framework Presence module accepts non-string keys from join payloads, causing channel state corruption and denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-120539 — Web Security
item.description: Allows unauthenticated remote code execution by evaluating attacker-controlled URIs via PHP's eval(), posing a critical threat to WordPress ecosystems.

item.title: CVE-2026-129448 — Web Security
item.description: Actively exploited deserialization flaw in Apache Roller enables unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint.

item.title: CVE-2026-130733 — Web Security
item.description: Exploits folder storage delimiter collisions to bypass page permissions, allowing unauthorized publishers to overwrite restricted content.

item.title: CVE-2026-130675 — Web Security
item.description: Enables remote code execution by instantiating arbitrary classes through Craft Commerce payment redirects, compromising entire CMS installations.

item.title: CVE-2026-130741 — Web Security
item.description: Bypasses the Twig sandbox using allowlisted array functions to read arbitrary server files, exposing sensitive configuration and keys.

item.title: CVE-2026-134292 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: SurrealDB's embedded JavaScript bridge skips function capability checks, allowing denied authenticated users to execute restricted database functions.

item.title: CVE-2026-134337 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: ArcadeDB native-image build lacks reflection metadata for SqlAstInspector, enabling authenticated clients to perform writes through read-only SELECT paths.

item.title: CVE-2026-134293 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: SurrealDB MCP server identifier validator incorrectly treats the first backtick as a closing delimiter, bypassing escape sequences and enabling SQL injection.

item.title: CVE-2026-134303 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: SurrealKV constructor only uses debug assertions for key length checks, allowing crafted SSTable blocks to trigger unchecked underflows and out-of-bounds reads.

item.title: CVE-2026-132660 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Unsafe search_path configurations in Postgres Enterprise Manager allow any connected user to escalate privileges by hijacking object resolution.

item.title: CVE-2026-132658 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Overly permissive agent roles grant read/write access to server files, enabling compromised hosts to exfiltrate or modify backend database contents.

item.title: CVE-2026-131202 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Combines lookup file uploads with Configuration Checker functionality to execute arbitrary code with elevated search head privileges in Splunk ES.

item.title: CVE-2026-131236 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious values into indexed events, which can later trigger arbitrary command execution when viewed by analysts.

item.title: CVE-2026-130709 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Permits authenticated users to execute JavaScript via SSTI in Handlebars webhook helpers, breaking isolation within the NocoDB platform.

item.title: CVE-2026-125396 — Other
item.description: Ghostscript's .putgstringcopy procedure calls privileged operators without type checking, allowing crafted PDFs to bypass the -dSAFER sandbox.

item.title: CVE-2026-134364 — Other
item.description: pypdf file identifier analysis enables attackers to guess placeholders in encrypted templated documents, leaking sensitive form data.

item.title: CVE-2026-95619 — Other
item.description: Integer overflow in libstdc++'s aligned new operator causes undersized memory allocations for large inputs, risking heap corruption in C++ applications.

item.title: CVE-2026-132825 — Other
item.description: Heap-based buffer overflow during character case conversion in Ruby can lead to memory corruption and potential code execution in affected runtimes.
